notice.ko: 공고 자동수집은 best-effort이며 누락 가능 — 아래 공식 잡보드에서 직접 확인 권장.
notice.en: Automated collection of postings is best-effort and may miss items — please confirm directly on the official job boards below.

context.ko: 시드 워치리스트(data/postdoc_watchlist.json)의 그룹 페이지와 잡보드를 매주 확인해 채웁니다. 2026-09-14 확인 결과, LBNL Helms 공고는 여전히 ‘게시가 내려갈 때까지 접수’ 문구를 달고 살아 있었습니다. 마감일이 지난 UCL 교원 공고(9월 7일)는 목록에서 내렸고, Faraday 잡보드에서 Agratas와 CPI의 배터리 연구직 두 건을 새로 확인해 추가했습니다. MEET의 연구원(E 13 TV-L) 공고는 개별 URL이 HTTP 410으로 사라졌습니다 — MEET 채용 페이지 자체에는 같은 직함이 남아 있으나 직전 회차의 딥링크가 죽었으므로 링크를 채용 페이지로 내리고 상태를 재확인으로 되돌렸습니다. Ceder 그룹 페이지는 이번에 직전의 ‘실험 포닥 4자리’ 대신 전산·실험·머신러닝 세 분야로만 안내하고 있어 설명을 그에 맞게 고쳤습니다. 케임브리지 화학과는 포닥 5건이 열려 있으나 여전히 배터리·전기화학은 없습니다. ECS 잡보드(jobs.electrochem.org)는 세 회차 연속 HTTP 403으로 차단돼 Sandia 항목은 또 재확인하지 못했습니다. data/pi_archive.json은 71명을 기록 중이나 flag가 붙은 PI가 아직 없어 ‘아카이브 2회+’ 항목은 이번에도 추가하지 않았습니다.
context.en: This list is filled each week by checking the group pages and job boards in the seed watchlist (data/postdoc_watchlist.json). As of 14 September 2026 the LBNL Helms posting is still live and still states that applications are accepted until it is removed. The UCL faculty post has passed its 7 September deadline and has been taken off the list, while two new battery research roles — at Agratas and CPI — were confirmed on the Faraday board and added. The MEET Research Associate (E 13 TV-L) posting has lost its individual URL, which now returns HTTP 410; the MEET jobs page still carries the same title, but last run's deep link is dead, so the link has been demoted to the jobs page and the status returned to needs-re-check. The Ceder group page now advertises only three areas — computational, experimental, and machine learning — rather than the four named experimental slots of last run, and the description has been corrected accordingly. Cambridge Chemistry has five open postdoc roles, still none in batteries or electrochemistry. The ECS job board (jobs.electrochem.org) returned HTTP 403 for the third run running, so the Sandia item again could not be re-checked. data/pi_archive.json now holds 71 names but none yet carries a flag, so no '2+ in archive' item was added this run either.

items.title: 포닥 모집 — 전산 설계 · 실험 합성/분석 · 머신러닝
items.title_en: Postdoc openings — computational design, experimental synthesis and characterisation, machine learning
items.desc: 2026-09-14 확인 시 에너지 소재의 전산 설계, 실험 합성·분석, 머신러닝/AI 세 분야로 포닥을 모집하고 있었습니다. 시작 시점은 협의 가능하며 국적 제한이 없다고 명시돼 있고, 지원은 전산(ceder-hr-comp@lbl.gov)과 실험(ceder-hr-exp@lbl.gov) 주소가 분리돼 있습니다. 직전 회차에 보였던 ‘실험 포닥 4자리’ 세부 목록은 이번 확인에서는 노출되지 않았습니다.
items.desc_en: As of 14 September 2026 the group is recruiting postdocs in three areas: computational design of energy materials, experimental synthesis and characterisation, and machine learning and AI. Starting dates are negotiable and the page states explicitly that there are no citizenship restrictions, with separate application addresses for computational (ceder-hr-comp@lbl.gov) and experimental (ceder-hr-exp@lbl.gov) roles. The itemised list of four experimental openings visible last run was not shown this time.

items.desc_en: A postdoc posting on LBNL's official recruiting system, reopened on 14 September 2026 and confirmed still live. The 19 August priority review date has passed, but the posting still states that applications are accepted until it is removed, so it remains open.

items.title_en: Postdoc: Modeling Batteries and Battery Systems

items.desc_en: A modelling postdoc posting confirmed as listed in late July. It was found through the ECS job board, which returned HTTP 403 again on 14 September 2026, so its continued listing has now gone three runs without confirmation.

items.desc_en: Reopened on 14 September 2026: the page is still reachable, but it was posted six months ago and states no deadline, so it cannot be confirmed as still being filled. Check Argonne's own careers site before applying.

items.title: Research Scientist — 전고체 · 리튬황 전지 R&D
items.title_en: Research Scientist — solid-state and lithium-sulfur battery R&D
items.meta_en: Gelion (via the Faraday Institution job board)
items.desc: Faraday Institution 잡보드에 올라온 산업계 R&D 공고로, 전고체와 리튬황 전지를 다룹니다. 2026-09-14 확인 시 잡보드에 마감일이 9월 14일로 표시돼 있어 오늘이 마지막 날입니다. 포닥은 아니지만 박사 후 진로로 함께 볼 만해 남겨 둡니다.
items.desc_en: An industry R&D role listed on the Faraday Institution job board, covering solid-state and lithium-sulfur batteries. As of 14 September 2026 the board still shows a 14 September closing date, so today is the last day. It is not a postdoc, but is kept here as a comparable post-PhD route.

items.title: Senior Solid-State Scientist
items.meta_en: Agratas (via the Faraday Institution job board)
items.deadline_en: Needs re-checking — no closing date shown on the board
items.desc: 2026-09-14 확인 시 Faraday 잡보드에 새로 올라와 있던 전고체 선임 연구직입니다. Agratas는 타타그룹의 영국 배터리 셀 제조사로, 산업계 전고체 트랙에 해당합니다. 잡보드에 마감일이 표시되지 않아 개별 공고에서 직접 확인해야 합니다.
items.desc_en: A senior solid-state research role newly visible on the Faraday board as of 14 September 2026. Agratas is Tata Group's UK battery cell manufacturer, so this is an industrial solid-state track. The board shows no closing date, so that must be checked against the posting itself.

items.title: Senior Research Scientist — Battery Materials
items.meta_en: CPI (via the Faraday Institution job board)
items.deadline_en: Needs re-checking — no closing date shown on the board
items.desc: 2026-09-14 확인 시 Faraday 잡보드에 함께 올라와 있던 배터리 소재 선임 연구직입니다. CPI는 영국의 공정 스케일업 전문 기관으로, 실험실 수준 소재를 파일럿 규모로 넘기는 일에 가깝습니다. 마감일이 표시되지 않아 재확인이 필요합니다.
items.desc_en: A senior battery-materials research role listed alongside it on the Faraday board as of 14 September 2026. CPI is a UK process scale-up organisation, so the work sits closer to taking laboratory-scale materials to pilot scale. No closing date is shown, so it needs re-checking.

items.title: 배터리·전기화학 포닥 공고 없음 (일반 포닥 5건은 진행 중)
items.title_en: No battery or electrochemistry postdoc posting (five unrelated postdoc roles are open)
items.desc: 2026-09-14 확인 시 화학과 잡보드의 포닥 공고는 2건에서 5건으로 늘었지만, 실내공기질(9월 15일), 실험 양자광학(9월 18일), 비평형 동역학의 핵 양자효과(9월 18일), 미지정 1건(9월 22일), 2인 모집(10월 2일)로 배터리·전기화학과 무관합니다.
items.desc_en: As of 14 September 2026 the department's job board has grown from two open postdoc roles to five — indoor air quality (15 September), experimental quantum optics (18 September), nuclear quantum effects in non-equilibrium dynamics (18 September), one unspecified role (22 September) and a two-post advert (2 October) — none in batteries or electrochemistry.

items.title: 포닥 공고 만료
items.desc: 기존 공고가 만료됐고 2026-09-14 확인 시에도 신규 공고는 확인되지 않았습니다. Faraday 잡보드에는 옥스퍼드 공학과 포닥이 여전히 언급되나 마감일 표기가 없고 해당 그룹 공고인지도 확인되지 않아 별도 항목으로 올리지 않았습니다.
items.desc_en: The previous posting has expired and no new one was found as of 14 September 2026. The Faraday board still mentions postdoc roles in Oxford's Department of Engineering Science, but they carry no closing date and are still not confirmed as belonging to this group, so they are not listed separately.

It cannot be told apart whether the same role was re-advertised or only the list entry remains, so the link has been demoted to the jobs page and the item marked for re-check. The page also invites unsolicited applications when nothing is advertised.

items.desc_en: As of 14 September 2026 the careers page again listed only a student assistant role and no postdoc posting. It invites candidates to contact the relevant research group leader directly even when nothing is advertised.
